_comment: Knobs only - profile personality lives in pi/profiles/<name>/AGENTS.md.
defaultTools is ADDITIVE (+name), never a replacement list. Passing --tools
on the CLI REPLACES the selection and filters MCP tools out of the callable
registry, starving codemode of everything it exists to call.
Kept deliberately short: prose lives in pi/README.md. Unknown keys are
tolerated at 1.0.0 (verified), but a stricter Pi release should not be
able to fail the boot over a comment.
